code_help: 7.RP.A.2 reads as: grade 7, Ratios and Proportional Relationships, cluster A, standard 2.

standards.summary: Use a letter to stand for a number that can change.
Solve a simple one-step equation to find an unknown value.
Write an equation linking two quantities where one depends on the other.
Use ratios and rates to solve real problems.
Recognise when two quantities rise together in a fixed ratio, and find that ratio.
Set up and solve an equation from a word problem.
Understand a function as a rule giving exactly one output for each input.
Work out the rate of change between two quantities and use it to predict.
Read a proportional relationship off a graph and interpret its steepness.
Rearrange a formula to solve for whichever quantity you need.
Read a formula and say what each part of it means.
